test_Index_union: test the pandas Index union method to compute the union of two Index objects
test_Index_intersection: test the pandas Index intersection method to compute common elements between two Index objects
test_Index_difference: test the pandas Index difference method to compute elements in one Index but not another
test_Index_symmetric_difference: test the pandas Index symmetric_difference method to compute elements in either Index but not both
test_Index_sort_validation: test the pandas Index set operations sort parameter validation for union, intersection, difference, and symmetric_difference
